cards.q_text: What is the carbon conversion factor for HFO and methanol? Calculate CO2 emitted for one day's fuel consumption.
cards.missing_limb: The card states MGO/MDO Cf = 3.206 and twice calls it counterintuitive, but never explains WHY the cleaner distillate carries the higher Cf.
cards.limb_sentence: The current answer lacks the mechanism behind the counter-intuitive MGO-over-HFO carbon factor.
changed_sections: answer-body: new h4 'Why the cleaner distillate carries the higher Cf' + 3 paragraphs
authority: IMO Res. MEPC.364(79), 2022 EEDI Guidelines, Table 1 - carbon content 0.8744 (ISO 8217 DMX-DMB) vs 0.8493 (RME-RMK); Cf defined as 'based on carbon content'

cards.q_text: What is a dual fuel engine and a tri-fuel engine? Alarms, monitoring vs conventional engine? LPG bunkering procedures?
cards.missing_limb: The card covers only the automatic 40% LEL gas trip. It never describes the operator-initiated changeover in either direction, nor the purge/ramp sequence or the before/after confirmations.
cards.limb_sentence: The current answer lacks the planned, operator-commanded fuel-mode changeover in both directions.
changed_sections: answer-body: new h4 'Changing fuel mode on purpose - the two directions' + 2-item list + contrast paragraph
authority: Wartsila dual-fuel engine documentation - automatic transfer to gas operation permitted at maximum 80% load; gas-to-diesel transfer available at any load
Wartsila Gas Valve Unit - gas line inerted with nitrogen; on gas trip the gas pipe is vented and purged with inert gas

cards.q_text: Compare methane slip control between the MAN ME-GA (Otto-cycle, two-stroke) engine and low-pressure Otto-cycle 4-stroke dual-fuel engines.
cards.missing_limb: ME-GI appears only once, inside a trap answer. It is absent from the comparison proper, as is the account of how combustion actually proceeds in each cycle - which is what makes the slip behaviour differ.
cards.limb_sentence: The current answer lacks ME-GI as a member of the comparison and the combustion mechanism that separates Diesel-cycle from Otto-cycle slip.
changed_sections: answer-body: new h4 'The Missing Member - ME-GI, and Why Cycle Beats Stroke Count' + list + 3 paragraphs
authority: MAN Energy Solutions, 'Managing methane slip' - ME-GI runs the Diesel combustion process; gas injected into compressed charge air around TDC slightly after the pilot has ignited; gas enters only after the exhaust valve has closed so no escape during scavenging and virtually none trapped in crevice volumes; slip quantified and guaranteed at 0.20-0.28 g/kWh over the load range; Otto-cycle DF engines have inherently higher slip; ME-GI needs EGR or SCR for Tier III; Otto engines knock-limited, want methane number around 70
MAN B&W ME-GI fuel gas supply system - gas delivered at approximately 300 bar
claims_added: Tier III via EGR or SCR

cards.q_text: NOx Technical File - what is it, what does it contain, and what does the surveyor check?
cards.missing_limb: The card lists an approved components list and says the surveyor checks approved components, but never says where the component identification is physically found, who issues it, or how the part-to-file match is actually made.
cards.limb_sentence: The current answer lacks where the approved-component number physically lives, who allocates it, and how the surveyor matches part to file.
changed_sections: answer-body: new h4 'Matching the Part to the File - Where the Number Actually Is' + 3 paragraphs
authority: NOx Technical Code 2008 (MEPC.177(58)) s1.3.3 - components are interchangeable parts influencing NOx performance, identified by their design/parts number
NTC 2008 s2.4.1.1/.2 - Technical File shall contain identification of components and the full range of allowable alternatives
NTC 2008 s6.2.3.1 - documentation inspection plus actual inspection of components as necessary
NTC 2008 s6.2.3.2 - surveyor may check one or all identified components and that only components of the approved specification are used
NTC 2008 s6.2.2.7.1 - Record Book of Engine Parameters records all changes including like-for-like replacements
